integrity.arithmetic_step: The shifted staircase product and Legendre valuation reduce exactly to a binary digit sum.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The earliest cited source is arXiv:math/0112261, submitted 2001-12-23; the algebraic-geometric source arXiv:math/0306338 was submitted 2003-06-24.
integrity.geometric_degree_step: The one-box classical Pieri rule identifies the top power of the Picard generator with saturated chains of strict partitions.

scientific_limitations: The degree is for the minimal half-spin embedding of a maximal orthogonal Grassmannian over the complex numbers.
Only the two-adic valuation is classified; odd-prime divisibility is not addressed.
The originality search cannot exclude an unindexed older observation obtained from the same classical formulas.
title: Exact two-adic valuation of spinor-variety degrees
